steps.en: Install the harness once — clone the repo and run the installer
steps.zh: 一次性安装套壳——克隆仓库并跑安装脚本

steps.en: Enable Ralph in an existing project, importing tasks from a PRD
steps.zh: 在现有项目启用 Ralph，从 PRD 导入任务

steps.en: Scaffolds the .ralph/ workspace — goals in PROMPT.md, tasks in fix_plan.md
steps.zh: 生成 .ralph/：PROMPT.md 写目标、fix_plan.md 列任务

steps.en: Review the checklist, then start the monitored loop
steps.zh: 核对任务清单，启动带监控的循环

steps.en: Each loop re-invokes Claude Code; rate limit and circuit breaker cap cost and stalls
steps.zh: 每轮重新调用 Claude Code，速率限制与熔断器框住成本和死循环

steps.en: Exits only when completion heuristics AND EXIT_SIGNAL: true both fire
steps.zh: 完成启发式与 EXIT_SIGNAL: true 同时成立才退出

value.en: The checklist gets ground down unattended and the loop stops when work is provably done — not when Claude declares victory
value.zh: 清单被无人值守啃完，循环在完成判据同时成立时才停——而不是 Claude 自称完成时

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09 (Quick Start, Phase 1): git clone https://github.com/frankbria/ralph-claude-code.git; ./install.sh
README.md main @ 2026-09 (Quick Start, Phase 2 Option A): ralph-enable --from prd ./docs/requirements.md; ralph --monitor
README.md main @ 2026-09 (Ongoing Usage + .ralph/ files table): PROMPT.md, fix_plan.md under .ralph/

README.md Project Status @ 2026-09: dual-condition exit gate (completion indicators + EXIT_SIGNAL: true), rate limiting 100 calls/hour configurable, circuit breaker (3 no-progress loops / 5 identical errors)
